title: 5BR with Pool, Hot Tub, Putting Green & Trampoline
description:
Looking for a great deal? Discounts are automatically applied based on your length of stay—whether it’s 5 nights, 7 nights, 28 nights, or more! No need for promo codes or requests. The total price you see includes your savings, so you can book with confidence. Discounts may display differently across booking platforms, but rest assured, they’re built into your final price!

 The space 
This home was temporarily unavailable for bookings but has now reopened! It has been well maintained throughout that time, and you're invited to enjoy the same exceptional stay that earned so many five-star reviews.

***NOT PET OR ESA FRIENDLY***

***Summer month stays (June - August): minimum temperature setting for the AC will be 72 degrees to prevent the heat pump system from being overworked and causing a malfunction with the cooling capabilities***

Check out this amazing resort-like home located in sunny Mesa, AZ! With over 4,600 sq ft of inside living space for all to enjoy, it also boasts an impressive outdoor living experience. Soak up as much sun as you desire by taking full advantage of the spa, pool with waterslide, lounge chairs, putting green, in-ground trampoline, and half court basketball area. The outdoor built-in gas BBQ grill is also a must to keep mealtimes simple, and at night, all can relax around the gas fire pit while exchanging fun stories about the day. As if that isn’t enough to create lasting memories together, inside there is a ping pong table and a large Connect Four game in the loft.

This home is limited to single family residential use. Under the HOA’s requirements, groups of more than four adults must be related by blood, marriage, or legal adoption. Groups of up to four unrelated adults occupying the home together as a common household are permitted. By booking, guests agree their group complies with this requirement.

When you first arrive at the house, unload all your bags to start getting settled. Once you’ve had a minute to refresh, get everyone involved in cooking up a fresh cooked meal together. The large kitchen has plenty of counter space and is fully equipped, which makes cooking for 12 easy. The large dining table can seat everyone together, so no one has to feel left out. After a long day of adventure, many may be ready to unwind before crashing for the night. Movie night on the 86” smart TV with a couple bowls of popcorn or some quiet time in your private space can be a great way to wrap up the day.

In the morning, brew up a pot of coffee and relax on the back patio before the rest of the house starts to wake up. Set up a breakfast buffet on the island bar area for all to enjoy as they mosey on down after getting ready for the day ahead. Hiking is practically outside the front door with only a 10-minute drive to the mountains, but there are also plenty of other places to explore nearby in the city (see Location Highlights below).

SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (sleeps 12):

Primary Suite (Upstairs):

- King bed

- Private bathroom with double sink vanity, walk-in shower, and jetted tub

- Nightstands

- Ceiling Fan

Guest Ensuite (Downstairs):

- King bed

- Private full bathroom with tub/shower combo

- 65" Smart TV

- Nightstands

- Ceiling Fan

Guest Bedroom #1 (Upstairs):

- King bed

- Nightstands

- Ceiling Fan

- Shared bath with double sink vanity

Guest Bedroom #2 (Upstairs):

- King bed

- Nightstands

- Ceiling Fan

- Shared bath with double sink vanity

Guest Bedroom #3 (Upstairs):

- Two (2) Twin over Full bunk beds

- Jack and Jill full bath with shower/tub combo (shared with upstairs loft area)

- Ceiling Fan

SECURITY: There are several cameras on the property that are RECORDING. They are not monitored and will not be accessed unless absolutely necessary to resolve a safety, security, or complaint issue. Camera Locations: Doorbell area, Corner of house by garage door, Corner of house near fountain/front sidewalk area, and on each end of the Upper balcony area on backside of house

ADDITIONAL AMENITIES:

- OPTIONAL: Heated pool available upon request and with paid heating fee

- Each bathroom comes with one set of hotel size amenities: shampoo, conditioner, body wash, and bar soap

- Kitchen with all major appliances and drip/pod coffee maker (starter set of dish soap and dishwasher pods provided)

- Kitchen bar area: seats 2

- Eat-in bar area: seats 3

- Dining table: comfortably seats 12

- Washer and Dryer (starter detergent pods provided)

- Parking: Driveway - up to 4 vehicles, no street parking allowed per HOA

LOCATION HIGHLIGHTS:

- Quiet, peaceful gated community (quiet hours begin at 10pm and end at 8am - all activity must be brought inside during that timeframe)

- Various restaurants nearby

- Hiking at Usery Mountain Regional Park: 10 minutes

- Golf: 10 minutes

- Air Force Museum: 10 minutes

- Denim and Diamonds (country dancing bar): 10 minutes

- Mesa Swap Meet: 15 minutes

- i.d.e.a. Museum: 20 minutes

- Barleens Dinner Show: 20 minutes

- Topgolf/Main Event: 20 minutes

- Golfland Sunsplash (mini golf and seasonal water park): 20 minutes

- Bell Bank Park Sports Complex: 20 minutes

- Seasonal:

 - Renaissance Festival (February): 20 minutes

 - MLB Spring Training (March): 15-25 minutes (Cubs, A’s, Rockies, and Diamondbacks)

 - Salt River Tubing (Summer): 15 minutes

This property is professionally managed, so you will receive communication regarding your reservation and check-in procedures from an iTrip email address.

 Other things to note
